integrity: The proof is unconditional and separates the divisor-count partition argument from the Euclid--Euler analysis of the two low-multiplicity shapes. The equality layer is proved in both directions. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The result gives a sharp lower multiplicity boundary and an exact characterization of the equality layer, but it does not prove that the cyclotomic--Mersenne equality layer is empty and therefore does not settle whether odd sublime numbers exist.
title: The first possible odd sublime layer
